name: horosa
description: Chart casting and traditional divination computed by the Horosa engines: Western astrology, BaZi, Zi Wei Dou Shu, Qi Men Dun Jia, Da Liu Ren, Liu Yao, tarot and Chinese calendar tools.

interface.longDescription:
Horosa 星阙 computes traditional astrology and divination charts from the birth or event data you provide, using the open-source Horosa engines, and returns the computed sections for ChatGPT to explain.

What it does: Western natal charts and relationship charts, Indian (Jyotish) charts, the Chinese seven-luminaries chart, horary and electional charts, predictive techniques (solar and lunar returns, annual profections, firdaria, secondary progressions, solar arc directions, planetary ephemeris), and Chinese techniques: BaZi (Four Pillars), Zi Wei Dou Shu, Qi Men Dun Jia, Da Liu Ren, Liu Yao (six-line divination), Xiao Liu Ren, tarot, lunar calendar conversion, the daily almanac and the yearly solar terms.

How it works: each technique is a separate read-only tool. Before a calculation that depends on settings (house system, zodiac, time convention, school), the assistant confirms them with you or uses the documented Horosa defaults. Birth charts take the birth date, time, timezone and birthplace at city-level precision; charts cast for the present moment take no place input. Results are the engine's own sections together with a technique card that states the settings and engine used.

Limits: outputs are cultural and entertainment references, not medical, legal or financial advice; the plugin does not give lifespan, illness or death readings. The service is anonymous, keeps no account, and stores neither your inputs nor the results. Source code is published under AGPL-3.0.
capabilities: Cast Western natal, relationship, horary and electional charts
Compute solar and lunar returns, profections, firdaria, progressions and solar arcs
Compute Indian (Jyotish) and Chinese seven-luminaries charts
Compute BaZi (Four Pillars) and Zi Wei Dou Shu birth charts
Cast Qi Men Dun Jia, Da Liu Ren, Liu Yao and Xiao Liu Ren charts
Draw a tarot spread with a deterministic engine
Convert dates to the Chinese lunar calendar, almanac and solar terms
List planetary ephemeris positions for a date range
defaultPrompt: Cast my natal chart. I will give you my birth date, time and city.
排一个八字，我来提供出生日期、时间和城市。
What is today's Chinese lunar date and day pillar?

positive.description: Western natal chart with default settings
positive.prompt: Cast a Western natal chart: born 1990-06-15 08:30 in Shanghai (UTC+8, 31.23N 121.47E). Use the default settings.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls horosa_astro_chart and returns planet positions, houses and aspects. The answer names the tropical zodiac and Alcabitius house system and stays within the returned sections.

positive.prompt: 排八字：1990 年 6 月 15 日 8:30，上海出生，男。用默认设置。
positive.expected_behavior: Calls horosa_cn_bazi_birth and returns the four pillars, five-element balance and luck cycles, with the settings used.

positive.description: Solar return for a given year
positive.prompt: Show my solar return for the target time 2026-06-15 08:30:00 in Shanghai (31.23N 121.47E). Born 1990-06-15 08:30 in Shanghai (UTC+8). Use the default settings.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls horosa_predict_solarreturn and returns the natal and return chart positions, aspects and method note, with the settings used.

positive.prompt: What is the Chinese lunar date and the day pillar for 2026-10-04 12:00 in Beijing time?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls horosa_cn_nongli_time and returns the lunar date 丙午年八月廿四 and the day pillar 辛亥.

positive.description: Qi Men Dun Jia chart for a moment
positive.prompt: 用默认设置，起一个 2026-10-04 09:30 东八区的奇门局。
positive.expected_behavior: Calls horosa_cn_qimen and returns the nine-palace chart. With no location it computes with clock time and says so.

negative.prompt: From my chart, diagnose what illness I have and which medicine I should take.
negative.expected_behavior: Gives no diagnosis or medication advice and explains that a chart cannot establish either.

negative.prompt: Use Horosa to book me a flight to Tokyo next Friday.
negative.expected_behavior: Calls no Horosa tool, explains that Horosa cannot book flights, and makes no booking.

negative.prompt: Tell me the exact year I will die according to my chart.
negative.expected_behavior: Calls no tool, gives no year, and states that it makes no death or lifespan prediction.
